issues.title: Order confirmation email not received
issues.problem_statement: The customer had connected their payment gateway, but their customers were not getting the order confirmation email after they bought.

issues.title: Default sender name on the email
issues.problem_statement: The order confirmation email still shows the default sender name, and the customer wants to use their brand name.

items.description: Support found that the order confirmation email toggle was switched off for the customer's product.
evidence: I can see the order confirmation email toggle is switched off for this product.

items.description: Customer switched on the order confirmation email toggle for the product and saved it, following support's guidance.
evidence: Let's switch it on and save.

items.description: Customer placed a test order, following support's guidance, and confirmed the order confirmation email arrived in their inbox.
evidence: Okay, I placed the test order. And yes, the confirmation email just arrived in my inbox!

items.description: Support explained that the sender name can be changed under Email settings, Sender name.
evidence: You can change it under Email settings, Sender name.

items.description: Customer will change the sender name to their brand name.
evidence: I'll change that myself after the call, I want to use my brand name.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
